SATURDAY LENTILS

This makes enough for four hungry people, and it takes about 40 minutes if you are not precious about the chopping.

250g brown lentils
1 onion, finely diced
2 cloves garlic
sea salt, to taste
olive oil

Sweat the onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Add the lentils and twice their volume of water. Simmer until the lentils give way but still hold their shape. Season with sea salt.
